title: SimulationProfile
description: Inputs for a single Monte Carlo run. Source of truth is the Pydantic model SimulationProfile in src/domain/simulation/profile.py. Regenerated via `make contracts`.

horizon.description: Trading days simulated per path. Invariant (Defining Q1.6).

numberOfPaths.description: Number of Monte Carlo trajectories. Invariant (Defining Q1.6).

initialCapital.description: Portfolio value at t=0. Plain float in v1; promote to Decimal if a real-money vendor is integrated (Defining 200-Q1.6).

seed.description: uint64 RNG seed. If null, the engine generates one and persists it (Defining Q1.6 invariant).

kind.description: mockCsv in v1; futureVendorApi reserved per ADR-001.

path.description: Required when kind=mockCsv. Relative path inside the container, e.g. 'data/mock/returns.csv'.

vendor.description: Required when kind=futureVendorApi. Reserved for ADR-001 future seam.
